takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin reached 19.1%, up 190 basis points from a year ago, as operating income rose 21% to $1.78B on revenue up just 8% — Salesforce grew profit much faster than sales, and raised its full-year margin guidance.
takeaways.title: Margins hit a record

takeaways.text: Current remaining performance obligation — work customers have signed for and will pay for within a year — rose 10% to $26.5B. That locks in a large share of future subscription revenue in advance.
takeaways.title: Backlog keeps climbing

takeaways.text: Restructuring charges were $99M, double the $49M a year ago, and losses on strategic investments cost another $37M. Even after both, net income rose 13% to $1.43B, and Salesforce returned $4.3B to stockholders through share repurchases plus $0.4B in dividends.
takeaways.title: Restructuring doubled

verdict: Salesforce grew revenue 8% to $9.33B and expanded its GAAP operating margin to a record 19.1%, lifting net income 13% to $1.43B despite a $37M loss on its strategic investments.
